$description: C1XX Foundations · spacing. Component-level scale as rem multiples of the root size (1rem = 16px) per the rem-spacing-system method: 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 rem. Numeric names = the value in 4px units (space.4 = 1rem = 16px). Layout-level spacing (whole 24px rows) lives in layout.json as rhythm.*. CSS consumes these in rem so the whole rhythm scales with the root font size.

12.$description: = rhythm.2. Boundary between component and layout spacing.

size.$description: Control heights. All are multiples of 4; interactive targets are ≥ 44.

control-md.$description: Default button and input on desktop.

control-lg.$description: Primary CTA, mobile button and input.

touch-min.$description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (HIG / WCAG 2.5.8).

snap.$description: How the inventory's 63 site values map onto the scale. Anything > 48px is layout spacing and goes to rhythm.* instead.

font-size.$description: 1rem. Prototypes lock html { font-size: 16px; text-size-adjust: 100% } so browser zoom does not silently change the rhythm.

rules.$description: How to choose a step. From the rem-spacing-system method; a value that cannot be expressed on the scale was guessed and goes back to the table.

hierarchy.$value: inside a group < between groups < heading to content. Same-kind siblings: space.4 (1rem). Tightly related pair: space.1–2. Group to group: space.4–8. Heading to its content: space.6–8.

button.$value: vertical padding space.2–3 (0.5–0.75rem), horizontal padding space.4–5 (1–1.5rem): wide, not tall. Gap between buttons in a row = the button's horizontal padding.

container.$value: card / panel padding ≥ space.4 (1rem); default space.5 (1.25rem); editorial surfaces space.6 (1.5rem).

inner-vs-outer.$value: an element's inner padding is always smaller than its outer margin (icon-to-label gap < button margin).

method.$value: start one step too generous and tighten; never start tight and loosen. Check the whole screen converges to multiples of 0.25rem.
